prompt: Which team won the 2016–17 Championnat LNA season (86th season of the top-tier basketball league in Switzerland)?
answer: BBC Monthey (also known as Monthey or BBC Monthey-Chablais) won the 2016–17 Championnat LNA season, defeating the Lions de Genève 4–2 in the final.
